description: Installation of an air conditioning unit on top of the flat roof of existing back addition, to the rear elevation at second floor level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

- Drawing Nos.AG04; AG06; AG07; AG09;

- Plant Noise Assessment Report (Ref. 15064/PNA/1/260519, version 02, dated 19.05.2026) prepared by Auricl Acoustic Consulting.


To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The external sound level emitted from the air conditioning unit at the
development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background
sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact, in accordance with the Plant Noise Assessment Report (Ref. 15064/PNA/1/260519, version 02, dated 19.05.2026) prepared by Auricl Acoustic Consulting.

 The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding
premises is not adversely affected by noise from the AC unit in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - Prior to first use, the air conditioning unit at the development shall be mounted
with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.


To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - The air conditioning unit shall not operate between 23:00 and 07:00
hours unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Council Panning Authority.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not
adversely affected by noise in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local
Plan 201
